memberships.page_title: The Degree-Five and Degree-Six Conic Frontier
Fixed-Factor Conic Exclusions in Degrees Five and Six

statement: Under the stated invariant-gap and basepoint-free hypotheses, the fixed-factor conic leading-form patterns (g,e)=(1,2),(3,1) in degree five and (2,2),(4,1) in degree six cannot occur for a nonautomorphic Keller map.
title: Basepoint-Free Fixed-Factor Conic Strata Are Excluded in Degrees Five and Six
